CHEMISTRY — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CHEMISTRY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Acids and bases? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Acids and bases.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Acids and bases.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Acids and bases.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Acids and bases.

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Chemistry? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Chemistry.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Chemistry.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Chemistry.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Chemistry.

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Atom 1.3. The periodic Table 1.4. Chemical Bonding 1.5. Periodicity 2.0 Phys? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Atom 1.3. The periodic Table 1.4. Chemical Bonding 1.5. Periodicity 2.0 Phys.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Atom 1.3. The periodic Table 1.4. Chemical Bonding 1.5. Periodicity 2.0 Phys.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on The Atom 1.3. The periodic Table 1.4. Chemical Bonding 1.5. Periodicity 2.0 Phys.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Atom 1.3. The periodic Table 1.4. Chemical Bonding 1.5. Periodicity 2.0 Phys.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Salts ● Types of salts ● solubility of salts (chlorides, carbona? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Salts ● Types of salts ● solubility of salts (chlorides, carbona.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Salts ● Types of salts ● solubility of salts (chlorides, carbona.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Salts ● Types of salts ● solubility of salts (chlorides, carbona.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Salts ● Types of salts ● solubility of salts (chlorides, carbona.

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Periodicity ● Trends in groups I, II, VII, VIII and period 3 ● gradation in size? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Periodicity ● Trends in groups I, II, VII, VIII and period 3 ● gradation in size.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Periodicity ● Trends in groups I, II, VII, VIII and period 3 ● gradation in size.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Periodicity ● Trends in groups I, II, VII, VIII and period 3 ● gradation in size.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Periodicity ● Trends in groups I, II, VII, VIII and period 3 ● gradation in size.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Chemical Bonding ● valence electron in bonding ● bond type (ionic, covalent, dat? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Chemical Bonding ● valence electron in bonding ● bond type (ionic, covalent, dat.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Chemical Bonding ● valence electron in bonding ● bond type (ionic, covalent, dat.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Chemical Bonding ● valence electron in bonding ● bond type (ionic, covalent, dat.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Chemical Bonding ● valence electron in bonding ● bond type (ionic, covalent, dat.

11. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Periodic Table ● Development of the periodic table . ● Ion formation . ● For? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Periodic Table ● Development of the periodic table . ● Ion formation . ● For.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Periodic Table ● Development of the periodic table . ● Ion formation . ● For.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Periodic Table ● Development of the periodic table . ● Ion formation . ● For.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on The Periodic Table ● Development of the periodic table . ● Ion formation . ● For.

13. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A mixture of two liquids

14. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Atom? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Atom.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on The Atom.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Atom.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Atom.

16. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Periodicity ● Trends in groups I, II, VII, VIII and period 3 ● gradation in size and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Acids and Bases 2.2. Introduction to Salts 3.0 Organic Chemistry Page 15 of 40 1 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Acids and bases and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Salts ● Types of salts ● solubility of salts (chlorides, carbona and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Chemistry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain The Atom 1.3. The periodic Table 1.4. Chemical Bonding 1.5. Periodicity 2.0 Phys and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
